description: Streams a sender MUST answer with nothing: a length that is not 32, a length that is not its shortest varint, a stream shorter than its length, and bytes after the root

cases.name: a byte after the root
cases.reason: the request is the whole stream, so a byte after the root is not a request

cases.name: the root is one byte short
cases.reason: the stream holds 31 bytes of root

cases.name: a length of 31 followed by a whole root
cases.reason: the length is read first and must be 32

cases.name: the length 32 in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint is in its shortest form
